Regional Economic Resilience pilot program with NAB Foundation and Australian Business Volunteers (launching 2026).
specificity_rationale: Names Resilient Building Council, Resilience Ratings System self-assessment app, NAB Foundation Regional Economic Resilience pilot program (launching 2026 in Shoalhaven), Australian Business Volunteers, Climate Finance Asia F-JT Working Group, F-JT Guidelines for Banks.
